title: •Chokk
caption: •Chokk (V)
game_text: Deploys -1 to Tatooine. While with your non-droid character, if a battle was just initiated here, may use 1 Force to place Chokk in Used Pile; Interrupts may not be played until the weapons segment ends.
lore: Klatooinian bodyguard currently in the paid service of Jabba the Hutt. Chokk takes pride in his work, and he is very good at it.
